title: Output length growth bound
statement: Let $k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $S$ be a state type, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $M$ be a $k$-work-tape Turing machine with configuration $c$ on input $x$. After $t$ steps, the output length is at most the initial output length plus $t$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a $k$-work-tape Turing machine over Boolean symbols with states in $S$
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $x$
